title: Comfort for Jerusalem concerning the cup of drunkenness
description: Jerusalem, having drunk the cup of the Lord's wrath to the last drop, is comforted with the promise that the cup will be taken from her and given to her oppressors. God promises to remove sorrow and grant freedom to those who lay helpless, and to restore the people as His own [ref:Jes 51:17-23|Isaiah 51:17-23].
